Privacy Policy

Effective {{POLICY_DATE}}. Version 1.

1. Who we are

The controller of your personal data is {{OPERATOR_NAME_EN}} (Individual Entrepreneur {{OPERATOR_FIO_EN}}, Russian Federation; OGRNIP {{OPERATOR_OGRNIP}}, INN {{OPERATOR_INN}}), "we", "us". Contact for any privacy matter: {{PD_EMAIL}}, postal address {{POSTAL_ADDRESS}}.

This policy covers the website sedlab.dev (the "Site"), the sign-in service auth.demo.sedlab.dev (the "Sign-in Service"), demo applications at *.demo.sedlab.dev (the "Demos"), our Max bot used for sign-in (the "Bot"), and communications and contracts with clients.

2. What we process, why, on which legal basis, and for how long

Purpose Data Legal basis (GDPR Art. 6(1)) Retention
Demo account and "live mode" with usage limits — sign-in, daily limits, abuse prevention, data export and deletion internal user ID; your account ID at the sign-in provider (Max, Yandex ID or VK ID); display name and login as provided by that provider (we do not request phone, email or photo); interface language; consent version and time; session IDs and expiry; which demos you opened (first/last visit, count); live-mode usage counters (b) performance of the Demo Terms you accept; for Russian-law purposes also your consent until you delete the account, or 12 months after your last sign-in (automatic deletion); encrypted backups rotate out within 6 months after deletion

We do not collect phone numbers or email addresses for demo accounts, do not process special categories of data (Art. 9) or payment card data (demos use payment sandboxes only), and do not make decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects based solely on automated processing (Art. 22). Applying a daily demo limit is not such a decision.

The services are intended for persons aged 18+.

3. Where your data is stored and who receives it

  • Primary storage — Russian Federation. The Sign-in Service database and the enquiry database are hosted at {{RU_HOSTING}} (Russia); encrypted backups at {{RU_S3}} (Russia). We are required by Russian law to store personal data of Russian citizens in Russia, and we apply the same storage to all users.
  • Demo servers — DigitalOcean, Frankfurt, Germany. They receive only an opaque user/session ID (no name, login or provider ID), the content you submit in live mode, and your IP address when you open a Demo.
  • Sign-in providers (Max, Yandex ID, VK ID — all in Russia). The provider you choose gives us your ID, name and login; with Max, our Bot sends you a confirmation message. Their own privacy policies apply. We do not use Telegram, Google or other foreign sign-in services.
  • Processing providers in live mode (speech-to-text, language models, text-to-speech), listed on each Demo page — e.g. OpenAI, L.L.C. and Anthropic, PBC (USA), Yandex Cloud and GigaChat (Russia). They receive only the content of your request, without identifiers.
  • Infrastructure providers (hosting, storage). Backups are encrypted before upload; the storage provider holds no key.
  • Authorities, only where required by law.

We do not sell personal data and do not share it for third-party advertising.

International transfers. If you are in the EEA, UK or Serbia, your data is collected by us directly and stored in Russia, a country without an adequacy decision. Where Chapter V GDPR applies, we rely on Art. 49(1)(b) (necessary for the performance of the Demo Terms or pre-contractual steps you request). Transfers to live-mode providers in the USA happen only when you use a Demo that names such a provider. EDPB Guidelines 05/2021: прямой сбор данных оператором вне ЕС у субъекта из ЕС — не «передача» по гл. V; проверить формулировку у юриста.

4. Your rights

You have the right to access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), and to object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21). You can withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier processing (Art. 7(3)).

  • Self-service: on auth.demo.sedlab.dev/account — "Download my data" (JSON) and "Delete account". Deletion immediately erases the account, sign-in methods, sessions, usage records and the interest record, and revokes all sessions.
  • By email: {{PD_EMAIL}}. We reply within one month (Art. 12(3)). If you write from Russia, we reply within 10 working days as required by Russian law.
  • Complaints: you may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority, e.g. an EU data protection authority, the Serbian Commissioner (Poverenik, poverenik.rs) or Roskomnadzor (rkn.gov.ru).

5. Cookies

We use only strictly necessary cookies: - sl_auth — session, 30 days; - sl_login — binds Max bot sign-in to your browser, 5 minutes; - sl_oauth — protects Yandex ID / VK ID sign-in (state, PKCE), 10 minutes ; - a temporary signed cookie that holds sign-in provider data until you accept the consent screen; it is deleted otherwise; - a language preference cookie .

No analytics or advertising cookies are set without your prior consent. Если появится аналитика — указать здесь и показать баннер.

6. Security

Our security measures: - data minimisation; - TLS everywhere; - tokens signed by the Sign-in Service in Russia; demo servers verify but cannot forge them; - restricted network access to internal APIs; - client-side encrypted backups; - access limited to the controller; - automatic deletion of inactive accounts.

We notify supervisory authorities and affected users of personal data breaches where required (GDPR Art. 33–34; Russian law: within 24/72 hours).

7. Changes

We publish updates on this page with a new effective date. If purposes or data change materially, we ask for consent again where consent is the basis.

The Russian version (sedlab.dev/privacy) prevails for data subjects in Russia.
